CustomField.description: How autosave paces its saves when Enable_Autosave__c is checked. "Upon Change" (default when blank) debounces 3 seconds after the respondent's last change with a 15-second max-wait cap, so continuous typing that keeps resetting the debounce still checkpoints; saves are entirely interaction-driven. "Every 10 Seconds" / "Every 30 Seconds" run a checkpoint clock that starts on the first interaction and skips any tick where nothing changed; any save (manual or auto) stops the clock until the next interaction. Unrestricted picklist per the managed-package value-propagation rule (#222).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose how autosave paces itself. "Upon Change" saves 3 seconds after the respondent stops making changes (at most 15 seconds after the first unsaved change during continuous typing) and is the recommended default; the timed options save on a 10- or 30-second checkpoint clock that only runs while the respondent is actively working and never saves when nothing changed.
CustomField.label: Autosave Mode
